findings.summary: codexHistory returns historical SHAs without review timestamps, so Task 22 cannot determine whether a full-review request followed the latest rewritten-away clean Codex review; preserve each historical marker's time and test that ordering.

The prescribed run-name is unquoted, so YAML treats `#${{ ... }}` as a comment and sets the title to `Gemini review PR`, preventing dispatched runs from matching Task 21's exact title or supplying Task 23's PR number; quote the complete value.

Task 20 Step 5 modifies `.github/pull_request_template.md` without listing it as a modify target, and Task 21 creates fixture files without create targets, leaving required changes outside the typed task targets and their conformance checks.
